description: Before sending USDT on Tron or Ethereum: will this transfer go through (frozen sender, unactivated account, too little USDT, too little TRX or ETH for the fee, a contract that refuses it, read off the chain with the exact fee), and should it go there at all (recipient OFAC-sanctioned, on Drain Watch, or frozen by Tether, where USDT arrives and can never leave). Answers do_not_send, will_fail, may_fail, goes_through or incomplete, and incomplete is not a clean result.

amount.description: USDT to send, like 250 or 12.5; leave out to check the whole balance

from.description: The sending address (Tron T... or Ethereum 0x...)

to.description: The recipient, on the same chain

name: veriql_send
title: Veriql USDT pre-send check
